messages:
Carmen (AE): Demo with SatoriTech failed live. Streaming response cut mid-sentence (~9s) and client threw JSON.parse error. Customer calling this a blocker for procurement.

Theo (solutions): bummer. Which model & network path? Any corporate proxy in the flow?

Carmen (AE): hosted api, model=redwood-chat-large, stream=true. User on Safari iOS behind their corporate gateway (ShieldWall). They recorded the browser console; pasted below.

Lin (eng): assigning. Quick hypothesis: ShieldWall is closing long-lived connections / transforming content (gzip) which results in truncated SSE chunks. Also check token rotation events around that time.

Harper (platform): infra logs show proxied 502 and client-side RST at 2012345701. Auth logs show a token refresh attempt at 2012345699 that returned a single 401 for that session. No global 429s from rate limiting.

Theo (solutions): here's the client console snippet the customer shared: 
```
EventSource connected
onmessage: chunk len=220
onmessage: chunk len=40 -> Uncaught SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input
reconnect in 1.0s
network error: net::ERR_CONNECTION_RESET
```

Lin (eng): can you give the exact curl they used? Also did they try bypassing ShieldWall?

Carmen (AE): curl they used: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.company/v1/stream?model=redwood-chat-large&stream=true"
```
They did test bypassing the gateway and stream stayed up.

Harper (platform): confirms pattern: bypass works; fails only via ShieldWall. ShieldWall applies deep packet inspection and has a 12s idle connection timeout and sometimes gzips if response headers allow. That would explain truncated event chunks.

Lin (eng): remediation plan: 1) Ask ShieldWall admin to whitelist `/v1/stream` and set idle timeout >= 60s, disable response transformation for `Accept: text/event-stream` (Cache-Control: no-transform). If they run nginx, recommend `X-Accel-Buffering: no`. 2) Short-term SDK guidance: buffer partial chunks and attempt to reassemble on reconnect. 3) Server-side improvements: send SSE comment heartbeats every 7s and include `retry:1500`. 4) Tolerate brief auth refresh races so a single 401 during token rotation doesn't force immediate abort.

Theo (solutions): customer wants a one-paragraph security explanation about token rotation.

Lin (eng): suggested text: "We use short-lived tokens with automatic refresh. The runtime allows an in-flight streaming request to complete during a short refresh window; transient 401s may be observed but we do not intentionally terminate a stream mid-event. Abrupt truncation is symptomatic of intermediate network devices closing or transforming the TCP stream."

Harper (platform): I'll open a canary to enable SSE heartbeats and the auth-tolerance flag for hosted fleet. deploy-bot: please schedule canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout queued: sse-heartbeat=7s, auth-tolerate-refresh=true (canary hosts: 4).

Carmen (AE): I'll send ShieldWall admin the notes and ask them to run a bypass test. Also share the SDK snippet for buffering.

Theo (solutions): SDK snippet to share now:
```
let partial='';
es.onmessage = e => { partial += e.data; try { const msg = JSON.parse(partial); handle(msg); partial=''; } catch(err) { /* wait for more data */ } };
es.onerror = () => { /* keep partial buffer and reconnect with backoff */ };
```

Lin (eng): created ticket INF-1510 to track SDK reassembly + INF-1511 for server auth tolerance rollout.

Harper (platform): monitoring note: last related failure at 2012345710, no new incidents since canary queued.

Carmen (AE): SatoriTech replied they will attempt bypass test tomorrow and confirm. Thanks all — will update when they validate. :raised_hands:
